In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of the expression of the glial intermediate filament protein glial fibrillary acidic (GFA) protein (GFAP).
the elucidation of signal transduction pathways regulating the expression of the glial fibrillary acidic (GFA) protein in rat C6 cells, which are a model for astrocytic differentiation.
the elucidation of the signal transduction mechanisms regulating GFAP expression in C6 gliomas.

GFAP expression in C6 gliomas is regulated by protein phosphorylation cascades that involve protein tyrosine kinases and adenylate cyclases.
